per_candidate_conclusions.source_fact: ReportOptions declares filters and documentation assigns dimension-filter meaning; destructuring reads it but request construction and returned results do not consume it.
per_candidate_conclusions.reason: The frozen source names the options field, not an SDK request field encoding. Treating [filters] as a missing SDK request path would invent that encoding. A whole-operand range is not a missing_field. Retain the supported logical-role concern via a suitable ordinary representation finding only if the representation itself is wrong, or a scoped typed barrier; do not fabricate a concrete field defect.

per_candidate_conclusions.source_fact: ReportOptions and documentation declare sort order; destructuring reads orderBy but request/result construction does not use it.
per_candidate_conclusions.reason: The options name does not establish the SDK field name. No existing source-supported concrete missing_field locator can be supplied at this SDK operation without an additional mapping claim.

The source explicitly names request.limit. Its falsy spread omits a supplied zero, so the concrete field coordinate is known. This repairs only the locator; it neither proves SDK treatment of zero nor resolves the simultaneous unfaithful-operation finding. Keep the conditional absence and action-only supported impact explicit.

ir119_representation_finding.explanation: The CFG already supplies the acquired client to each SDK instruction. The processed calls keep the request argument but drop its relationship to that client. A fixed service location cannot distinguish calls using different handle versions, including cache hits retaining creation-time credentials.
ir119_representation_finding.suggestion: Retain the existing handle as a receiver dependency of the paired SDK boundary, with its own provenance and scope. Keep it separate from the request object's fields and leave transport internals unresolved.

further_conflicts.meaning: Static inspection of the old prefix consistency rule identifies additional conflicts that the early schema error prevented from being reached. These counts are not validation/replay results and no candidate has been accepted.

old_global_failure_path: source_review.validate_source_review parses the complete response before validating individual contract tables; any source-input candidate failure raises a schema StructuralValidationError.
The one record correction selected only the three failed records; its prompt forbids addition/deletion and exposes only the first after-validator condition.
ResponseChain exhausted its one correction; run_source_review returned structural_failure with review=null.
input_contract_review._build_core requires status=complete with a review object; otherwise all checks, scope decisions, projections and source findings become empty.
runner requires a completed accepted review with findings for semantic repair, so no repair ran.

changes: Discriminated finding variants couple missing_argument to AbsentArgument, missing_field to MissingFieldInputRange, and wrong_field to ActualInputRange.
MissingFieldInputRange.path uses schema-visible minItems=1; existing concrete-path rule is not weakened.
Immutable Candidate and Normalized wrappers retain model_validate/model_dump and normal field reads, with flat JSON records and existing normalization APIs.
Exported SOURCE_INPUT_FINDING_GUIDANCE documents operation-relative operands, native output paths, source-role limits, faithful source transcription, and prohibition of guessed SDK fields.
No new accepted source-role omission kind and no speculative native-output shape validator were added.
implemented.migration: No current caller changes required; normalized JSON stays flat. The internal inheritance relationship changed to variant-backed RootModel records; no current isinstance dependency was found.

recommendations_for_root: Include the exported guidance in normal and correction review prompts, preserving existing calls/workers/budgets.
Validate independent records and consistency relations with precise coordinates so the bounded correction sees all presently demonstrable errors, not merely the first after-validator guard.

If adding local acceptance, retain invalid raw candidates and explicit localized unavailability; require identity, inventory completeness, evidence, pair binding and cross-record consistency for every independently accepted scope. Do not promote the historical 227 labels.
Separate global structural/entry-route limitations from assertions that each existing local transfer is unfaithful; any narrowed impact needs explicit typed bounds, not a prose guess.

Continue rejecting source-defect claims at an operation simultaneously declared unfaithful, including the ir119 receiver relation, unless separately bounded faithful facets are explicitly represented.
Keep historical artifacts/protocol identities immutable and bind new decisions to selected source, CFG, annotation, review and their current identities.
limits: This patch addresses strict locator expressibility and visible instructions only. Whole-review isolation and shared repair behavior belong to root-owned files. It does not establish that all three historical semantic candidates are correct or make historical reviews accepted.
